answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the veil and how it was used, so a short line on its making and its setting up is supported.

clauses.english: was made of blue, purple, scarlet and fine linen, with cherubims worked into it
clauses.quote: he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen

clauses.english: was set up to cover the ark of the testimony and divide the holy place from the most holy
clauses.quote: set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony

doubts: HEB 9:3 speaks of the second veil, which is not the same wording as the others; left unused.
LEV 16 and NUM 4 give rules for priests (entering within the veil, taking it down to cover the ark), which are commands, not events, so they were left out.
